title: Dynamic message-id emit sites in the ported simulation
readFrom: godot/src/sim/*.gd at the working tree state recorded in docs/wayfinder/evidence/i18n-port-contract.md
why: Literal emit sites (`add_event(state, "evChiquita")`, a ternary of literals) are found automatically by tools/i18n-port/emit-analysis.mjs. A site that computes its id — a `%` format or a bare variable — is invisible to that scan unless it is declared here.

So: every dynamic site must be declared, and every declared substitution must be re-derivable from the source it comes from. A new dynamic site fails the drift test until it is declared; a substituted value that no longer matches its source (someone added a fourth tactic, a new score reason, a fifth AI tier) fails too. That is the `AI_LEGGENDA_NAME` door, closed.
Declarations anchor on content, never on line numbers: this file must not go stale because someone inserted a line above it, only because the code actually changed.

serveFaultReason.why: the reason string serve_fault() is called with

scorePointReason.why: the reason string score_point() is called with, plus the double-fault template it builds itself

positionRole.why: the role id set_active_player() picks when it announces the switch

tactic.why: the pair-tactic suffixes; derived from the reference table's own `tactic_*` keys, so a tactic with no string cannot be declared here

anchors: var position := "roleBackPos" if state.paddle(key).y > float(Frozen.court()["netY"]) + 150.0 else "roleNetPos"
dynamicSites.resolution: the composite id `controlMsg:<role id>` is resolved by the `controlMsg` composite rule in tools/i18n-port/resolve-rules.json (placeholder binding), which reproduces js/game.js:455-456.

dynamicSites.note: Not dynamic — listed here only so the port's loss of the two parameters is recorded next to the other parameterised ids. js/game.js:2629 renders `t("serveHint", { ordinal, suffix })` at emit time; the port stores the bare id, so `{ordinal}` and `{suffix}` cannot be filled and the placeholders would reach the screen. Baselined in tools/i18n-port/unresolved-baseline.json as `no-params`.

anchors: var id := "evShotLong" if kind == "long" else ("evShotWide" if kind == "wide" else "evShotNet")

dynamicSites.resolution: the range comes from the frozen reference table (godot/src/sim/frozen/data.json `eventLines`, serialised from js/data.js EVENT_LINES): six lines, six keys eventLine0..eventLine5.

anchors: static func score_point(state: State, winner: String, reason: String, kind: Variant = null) -> String

dynamicSites.note: js/game.js:2123 emits `${reason} ${t("secondServeSuffix")}` where `reason` is already the rendered text of the call site's t(). The port composes two ids into one string that is not an id: `secondServe` is not a key (the key is `secondServeSuffix`) and there is no separator. Baselined in tools/i18n-port/unresolved-baseline.json as `no-key`.

dynamicSites.resolution: the preceding assignment sets `pointYou`/`pointOpp`; this line appends `:<reason id>`. Resolved by the `pointYou` / `pointOpp` composite rules (js/game.js:2110).

notes: `state.pointMessage = ""` (create_match_state) clears the field and is not an id site.
The `emits` lists are documentation of what the drift test derives independently — they are not read by the test, so a stale list cannot make it green.
